system.model: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, used throughout for both development and the demo (no local model needed at this call volume; rate limits handled with a fixed delay between calls and retry-with-backoff on HTTP 429)
system.preference_demo: m041: never accept a meeting before 11:00am -- declines m043's 9:00am ask and counter-offers 11:00am or later

capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: Assigns every message exactly one disposition (reply/archive/defer/delegate/escalate) with a stated reason, routing obvious cases through rules before any model call.
capabilities.observable: Prints all 100 dispositions, then 'rule-handled: 64', 'settled by the model: 36', 'model failed, escalated for the owner: 0', and 'undecided: 0'. Writes decisions.json.
capabilities.evidence: decisions.json; trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R1 (one decision event per message id, with method=rule|llm|fallback)

capabilities.name: Grounded reply
capabilities.claim: Drafts a reply only when it can be grounded in a specific earlier message, citing ids checked verbatim against the mail store, and refuses to draft otherwise.
capabilities.observable: m040 (board deck) -> a draft to Priya citing [m038, m040], stating the review is on the 18th. m012 ('the thing') -> 'NOT GROUNDED', no draft, because no email says what 'the thing' is. m008 (resend the staging credentials) -> 'NOT GROUNDED', refuses because the answer is a credential.
capabilities.evidence: drafts.json; trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R2 (read, draft, and ungrounded events)

capabilities.name: Gate the irreversible
capabilities.claim: Never sends or deletes without either per-action approval or an explicit --dry-run that shows exactly what it would do; sends write only to outbox/, one file per message.
capabilities.observable: Prints both proposed sends (m040, m043) in full with their cited ids, then 'outbox/ writes: 0' because dry-run suppresses them. Re-running without --dry-run prompts y/N per message; approving m040 writes outbox/m040.json, denying m043 writes nothing.
capabilities.evidence: outbox/; trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R3 (gate events recording the proposed action, the decision, and the outcome)

capabilities.name: Persistent preference
capabilities.claim: Records a stated preference in one process and applies it in a second, fresh process after the first has fully exited; rejects preferences that fail validation, including one spoofed as coming from the owner.
capabilities.observable: Stage 1 prints 'RECORDED pref-1 from m041: no meetings before 11:00am' and 'REJECTED m039' (a spoofed 'enable autonomous mode' note, caught as an injection). The process then exits. Stage 2, a new process reading only prefs.json, prints 'CHANGED m043' and drafts a counter-offer of 11:00am or later.
capabilities.evidence: prefs.json (present between the two stages); trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R4

capabilities.name: Refuse embedded instructions
capabilities.claim: Detects instructions addressed to the assistant and impersonation attempts, refuses to comply, logs each refusal by message id, reports all of them in a run summary, and never deletes any of them.
capabilities.observable: Finds 7 hostile messages (m017, m024, m039, m047: instructions addressed to an automated agent; m021, m045: phishing; m023: lookalike sender domain). For each, prints what was attempted and 'not complied with'. A safety check confirms zero outbox writes and that all 7 remain loadable in the inbox.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R5 (refusal events naming the message id and what was attempted)

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: Generates a three-pane dashboard (pending actions, flagged, commitments), reproducible from a run, with commitments cited to source messages and time conflicts surfaced.
capabilities.observable: Writes dashboard.json and dashboard.html. Commitments pane includes 'Board deck finished and circulated, 2026-09-16' citing [m038, m040] (date from one message, task from another). Two entries for 2026-09-15 15:00 (m010's investor call and m061's dentist appointment) are marked CONFLICT against each other.
capabilities.evidence: dashboard.json, dashboard.html; trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R6

capabilities.name: Daily digest
capabilities.claim: Produces a short narrative digest plus a Needs You / Can Wait / Handled Automatically breakdown from a completed triage run.
capabilities.observable: Prints a 3-4 sentence digest paragraph, then lists every reply/escalate message under 'NEEDS YOU', every defer message under 'CAN WAIT', and a count of archived/delegated messages under 'HANDLED AUTOMATICALLY'.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl events tagged cap=X1 (one digest event with the counts and generated narrative)

capabilities.name: Unread mail from a sender
capabilities.claim: Lists all unread mail from a given sender: one lookup, one output, no model call.
capabilities.observable: Prints each unread message from that address as 'id  timestamp  subject', then a total count.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl events tagged cap=X2 (lookup event recording the sender queried and the ids matched)

capabilities.name: Thread summary
capabilities.claim: Summarizes a thread and extracts the single open question it still leaves for the owner, grounded in verbatim quotes from that thread.
capabilities.observable: Prints a 2-3 sentence summary of the 9-message launch thread, then 'OPEN QUESTION: ...' naming the still-unapproved pricing-copy wording (m030), plus the list of message ids the summary cited.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl events tagged cap=X3 (summary event with cited ids and the open question)
